session_summary: As a first-time player, I selected the 'moss' route (Moss Trail) and completed all 12 steps, engaging with three encounters (Goblin, Slime, Kobold) along the way. The session finished successfully with a reward of 25 coins and ending health at 100.

observations.evidence: Successfully started on the 'moss' route and walked through to completion without getting lost or confused.
observations.recommendation: Keep the introductory Moss Trail straightforward as an onboarding baseline.

observations.evidence: Fought three distinct enemies (Goblin, Slime, Kobold) and maintained 100 HP throughout the entire 12-step session.
observations.recommendation: Ensure early combat scaling remains gentle for newcomers.

feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt
feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand combat interactions and movement mechanics immediately upon entering a route.
feature_requests.rationale: Without explicit intro text or tooltips during the first few steps, new players might wonder how actions map out.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a brief narrative hint or welcome message at step 0 explaining how walking and enemy encounters work.

keep: Moss Trail difficulty and pacing for new players
Clear step-by-step telemetry and completion messages
focus: onboarding, clarity, route choice, controls, first-session friction
